Farewell routines, explained for anyone with a companion animal
They often ask us about it

Farewell routines at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

When a traveler prepares to leave an Aurelia Skyways skyport with a companion animal, the desk follows a calm and steady routine. The purpose is to keep the animal settled, keep the traveler informed, and keep the handoff organized from start to finish.

The first step is to review the booking details and confirm the travel plan for the animal. Staff check that the carrier is suitable, that required items are present, and that the traveler understands any last checks before departure. If there is any concern, a safety coordinator reviews the situation and helps decide the safest next step.

Each animal receives patient attention from trained staff. The desk team speaks in a quiet tone, moves at a measured pace, and avoids unnecessary handling. This helps reduce stress and makes the farewell process easier for both the traveler and the animal. If a traveler has notes about comfort, feeding, or handling, those notes are followed carefully.

The desk also keeps records current. Service changes are entered in the desk ledger so the next team member can see what was done and what still needs attention. Clear records help maintain consistency across the transfer process and support smooth work between skyports.

Travelers are encouraged to remain nearby until the desk confirms that the farewell routine is complete. This allows any final adjustment to be made without delay and gives the team a chance to resolve small issues before departure begins.

For more help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
